transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to conduct the pre-job review for the hot-work repair on Resin Dryer 2 — the cracked access-panel hinge that requires welding a replacement hinge in place. As you know, the dryer is adjacent to the active compounding area, so we need to complete the documented pre-job review before I can authorize the permit. I need formal finding records submitted through the review process from each of the four functions: maintenance, environmental health and safety, production planning, and quality. Please submit your current findings and the controls needed for this work so we can get this recorded and I can authorize the repair.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My inspection found that the hinge cannot be repaired in place — the replacement requires exactly 4 hours of welding and cooling, followed by a separate 30-minute panel-fit check. I confirmed these durations with the repair contractor this morning but haven't entered them in the work-order system yet. For the permit decision, the repair_welding_hours field records only the welding and cooling portion, not the separate panel-fit check.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to submit my environmental health and safety finding for the pre-job review. My area assessment found residual combustible resin dust inside the dryer access zone. Because of that hazard, the permit must require two trained fire-watch attendants present during the entire 4-hour hot-work period and for 60 minutes afterward. I completed the dust survey yesterday but have not yet attached it to the permit file, though I'm submitting my formal finding record now with the required controls recorded.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to submit my production planning finding. I confirmed that Batch R-17 is scheduled to use Resin Dryer 2 immediately after the repair, and that batch must be held until the dryer passes its restart checks. I received the locked production sequence from the scheduling system this afternoon but have not yet circulated the hold instruction. For the record, the required control is: Batch R-17 must remain on hold until Resin Dryer 2 passes its post-repair restart checks before any production use begins.

My process review requires a 20-kilogram purge load and moisture verification before any production batch can be released after this repair. I recorded this requirement in the quality notebook during the last dryer qualification review but have not yet updated the restart checklist. I'm submitting my formal finding record now with the required control recorded: a 20-kilogram purge load and moisture verification must be completed before any production batch can be released from Resin Dryer 2 after this repair.
